description: Progressive-disclosure security investigation dashboard: L0 what-changed deltas, L1 attribution tables with drilldown, L2 evidence + SIEM handoff.

options.content:
Bot Insights -- What Changed + Investigation
Detect anomalies in bot traffic volume, error rates, and cache behavior. Start here when something looks wrong.
Data Freshness: ${data_freshness}

panels.description: Minutes since most recent ingested event. Green <30m, amber <120m, red >= 120m.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  greatest(dateDiff('minute', max(timestamp), toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 0) AS lag_minutes
FROM ${summary_minute}
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
  AND ${traffic_type_filter}
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Data Lag; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Data Lag

panels.description: Number of distinct CDN feeds reporting in the current window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  uniq(request_host) AS active_feeds
FROM ${raw_table}
WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND reqTimeSec < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
  AND ${traffic_type_filter}
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)

SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 15,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Collection; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Collection

panels.description: Bot traffic volume change vs prior equal-length window. Positive = increase.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  duration AS (
    SELECT greatest(dateDiff('second',
      toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}),
      toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})), 1) AS secs
  ),
  current_vol AS (
    SELECT cnt_all * $scale_factor AS vol
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
      AND ${traffic_type_filter}
      AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
  ),
  baseline_vol AS (
    SELECT cnt_all * $scale_factor AS vol
    FROM ${summary_table}
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE
      AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
      AND ${traffic_type_filter}
      AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
  )
SELECT
  if((SELECT vol FROM baseline_vol) > 0,
    round(((SELECT vol FROM current_vol) - (SELECT vol FROM baseline_vol)) / (SELECT vol FROM baseline_vol) * 100, 1),
    999) AS value
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Volume Delta; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Volume Δ

panels.description: Change in 429 rate vs baseline. Increasing = more rate-limiting pressure.

panels.description: Bot traffic as percentage of total requests in the current window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH bot AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    cnt_all * $scale_factor AS bot_cnt
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
    AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
    AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
    AND ${traffic_type_filter}
    AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
    AND is_bot_traffic = 1
  GROUP BY time
),
total AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    cnt_all * $scale_factor AS total_cnt
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
    AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
    AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
    AND ${traffic_type_filter}
    AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT
  t.time,
  b.bot_cnt * 100.0 / greatest(t.total_cnt, 1) AS value
FROM total t
LEFT JOIN bot b ON t.time = b.time
ORDER BY t.time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Bot Pct; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Bot %

panels.description: Stacked traffic volume: Human, Bot, AI Crawler. Spike patterns reveal when changes started.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  sumIf(cnt, is_bot_traffic = 0) AS human,
  sumIf(cnt, is_bot_traffic = 1 AND (ai_category = '' OR ai_category IS NULL)) AS bot,
  sumIf(cnt, notEmpty(ai_category)) AS ai_crawler
FROM (SELECT timestamp, is_bot_traffic, ai_category, cnt_all * $scale_factor AS cnt
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND ${traffic_type_filter}
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
  GROUP BY timestamp, is_bot_traffic, ai_category)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Bot Volume Over Time; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Bot Volume Over Time

panels.description: Top 20 ASNs by bot volume in the current window with baseline comparison.

targets.rawSql:
WITH current AS (
  SELECT
    client_asn,
    cnt_all * $scale_factor AS volume
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND ${traffic_type_filter}
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
    AND is_bot_traffic = 1
  GROUP BY client_asn
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT
    client_asn,
    cnt_all * $scale_factor AS volume
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE
      AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
      AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
      AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
      AND ${traffic_type_filter}
      AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
    AND is_bot_traffic = 1
  GROUP BY client_asn
)
SELECT
  cur.client_asn AS "ASN",
  cur.volume AS "Volume",
  coalesce(base.volume, 0) AS "Baseline",
  if(base.volume > 0, (cur.volume - base.volume) / base.volume * 100, 999) AS "Delta %"
FROM current cur
LEFT JOIN baseline base ON cur.client_asn = base.client_asn
ORDER BY cur.volume DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top ASNs by Delta; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top ASNs by Delta

panels.description: ASNs with bot traffic in the current window that were not seen in the prior lookback window.

targets.rawSql:
WITH current AS (
  SELECT
    client_asn,
    cnt_all * $scale_factor AS volume,
    min(timestamp) AS first_seen
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
  AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND ${traffic_type_filter}
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
    AND is_bot_traffic = 1
  GROUP BY client_asn
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT client_asn
  FROM ${summary_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${newly_seen_window} DAY
    AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
    AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
    AND ${traffic_type_filter}
    AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
    AND is_bot_traffic = 1
)
SELECT
  cur.client_asn AS "ASN",
  cur.volume AS "Volume",
  cur.first_seen AS "First Seen"
FROM current cur
LEFT ANTI JOIN baseline base ON cur.client_asn = base.client_asn
ORDER BY cur.volume DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Newly Seen ASNs; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Newly Seen ASNs

panels.description: Paths ranked by bot hit count. High bot % on API endpoints signals automated targeting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  path AS "Path",
  sum(cnt) AS "Total Hits",
  sumIf(cnt, bot_class NOT IN ('human', '')) AS "Bot Hits",
  round(sumIf(cnt, bot_class NOT IN ('human', '')) / greatest(sum(cnt), 1) * 100, 1) AS "Bot %"
FROM (
  SELECT
    request_path_norm AS path,
    bot_class,
    cnt_all AS cnt
  FROM ${path_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND ('${client_asn:text}' = 'All' OR (timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp >= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})))
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
    AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all'
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND bot_class NOT IN ('human', ''))
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND bot_class IN ('human', ''))
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND bot_class IN ('ai_data_scraper', 'ai_assistant', 'ai_search_crawler', 'ai_agent')))
    AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
  GROUP BY path, bot_class

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    request_path_root AS path,
    bot_class,
    count() AS cnt
  FROM ${raw_table}
  WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND reqTimeSec < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND ('${client_asn:text}' <> 'All' OR (reqTimeSec < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})))
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
    AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
    AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all'
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND bot_class NOT IN ('human', ''))
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND bot_class IN ('human', ''))
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND bot_class IN ('ai_data_scraper', 'ai_assistant', 'ai_search_crawler', 'ai_agent')))
    AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
    AND length(request_path_root) > 0
  GROUP BY path, bot_class
)
GROUP BY path
HAVING "Bot Hits" > 0
ORDER BY "Bot Hits" DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 30,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Top Paths by Bot Traffic; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Top Paths by Bot Traffic

panels.description: Volume change by bot category vs baseline. Shows which bot types are driving the delta.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  ua_cur AS (
    SELECT class_key, sum(volume) AS volume
    FROM (
      SELECT bot_class AS class_key, cnt_all AS volume
      FROM ${summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
        AND ${traffic_type_filter}
        AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
        AND is_bot_traffic = 1
      GROUP BY class_key
    )
    GROUP BY class_key
  ),
  ua_base AS (
    SELECT class_key, sum(volume) AS volume
    FROM (
      SELECT bot_class AS class_key, cnt_all AS volume
      FROM ${summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE
        AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
        AND ${traffic_type_filter}
        AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
        AND is_bot_traffic = 1
      GROUP BY class_key
    )
    GROUP BY class_key
  ),
  siem_cur AS (
    SELECT
      class_key,
      siem_bot_category,
      siem_bot_category_source,
      siem_bot_type,
      sum(volume) AS volume
    FROM (
      SELECT
        akamai_canonical_bot_class AS class_key,
        bot_category AS siem_bot_category,
        bot_category_source AS siem_bot_category_source,
        bot_type AS siem_bot_type,
        cnt_all AS volume
      FROM ${siem_class_summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
        AND notEmpty(bot_category)
      GROUP BY class_key, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
    )
    GROUP BY class_key, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
  ),
  siem_base AS (
    SELECT
      class_key,
      siem_bot_category,
      siem_bot_category_source,
      siem_bot_type,
      sum(volume) AS volume
    FROM (
      SELECT
        akamai_canonical_bot_class AS class_key,
        bot_category AS siem_bot_category,
        bot_category_source AS siem_bot_category_source,
        bot_type AS siem_bot_type,
        cnt_all AS volume
      FROM ${siem_class_summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE
        AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
        AND notEmpty(bot_category)
      GROUP BY class_key, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
    )
    GROUP BY class_key, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
  ),
  cur_total AS (
    SELECT sum(total) AS total
    FROM (
      SELECT cnt_all AS total
      FROM ${summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND timestamp <= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
        AND ${traffic_type_filter}
        AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
    )
  ),
  base_total AS (
    SELECT sum(total) AS total
    FROM (
      SELECT cnt_all AS total
      FROM ${summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) - INTERVAL ${duration} MINUTE
        AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds})
        AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
        AND ${traffic_type_filter}
        AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
    )
  ),
  siem_evidence AS (
    SELECT
      coalesce(sum(volume), 0) AS siem_event_count,
      coalesce(sum(volume) / nullIf((SELECT total FROM cur_total), 0), 0) AS siem_coverage_pct
    FROM siem_cur
  ),
  siem_threshold AS (
    SELECT siem_event_count, siem_coverage_pct,
      if(siem_event_count >= 20 OR siem_coverage_pct >= 0.05, 1, 0) AS meets_threshold
    FROM siem_evidence
  ),
  use_siem AS (
    SELECT if(
      '${classification_policy}' = 'akamai_authoritative'
      AND '${has_akamai_siem}' = '1'
      AND (SELECT meets_threshold FROM siem_threshold) = 1,
      1, 0
    ) AS flag
  ),
  canonical_cur AS (
    SELECT
      class_key AS canonical_bot_class,
      class_key AS display_bot_category,
      '' AS siem_bot_category,
      '' AS siem_bot_category_source,
      '' AS siem_bot_type,
      volume,
      'ua_dict' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
      'derived' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence
    FROM ua_cur WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      class_key AS canonical_bot_class,
      siem_bot_category AS display_bot_category,
      siem_bot_category,
      siem_bot_category_source,
      siem_bot_type,
      volume,
      'akamai_siem' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
      'authoritative' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence
    FROM siem_cur WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 1
  ),
  canonical_base AS (
    SELECT class_key AS canonical_bot_class, class_key AS display_bot_category, volume
    FROM ua_base WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT class_key AS canonical_bot_class, siem_bot_category AS display_bot_category, volume
    FROM siem_base WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 1
  )
SELECT
  cur.display_bot_category AS category,
  cur.canonical_bot_class,
  cur.siem_bot_category,
  cur.siem_bot_category_source,
  cur.siem_bot_type,
  cur.canonical_bot_class_source,
  cur.canonical_bot_class_confidence,
  (SELECT siem_event_count FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_event_count,
  (SELECT siem_coverage_pct FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_coverage_pct,
  multiIf(
    coalesce(base.volume, 0) = 0, 999.9,
    round(
      (cur.volume / nullIf((SELECT total FROM cur_total), 0)
       - coalesce(base.volume, 0) / nullIf((SELECT total FROM base_total), 0))
      / nullIf(coalesce(base.volume, 0) / nullIf((SELECT total FROM base_total), 0), 0) * 100,
    1)
  ) AS share_delta_pct
FROM canonical_cur cur
LEFT JOIN canonical_base base
  ON cur.canonical_bot_class = base.canonical_bot_class
 AND cur.display_bot_category = base.display_bot_category
ORDER BY share_delta_pct DESC
LIMIT 10
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 60,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Bot Category Volume Delta; du=${__user.login}'

panels.title: Bot Category Volume Δ

targets.rawSql:

  cnt_2xx AS "2xx",
  cnt_4xx AS "4xx",

  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)

panels.title: Status Mix Over Time

panels.description: HTTP method distribution by traffic cohort. High POST ratio from bots indicates form/API abuse.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  multiIf(
    bot_class IS NULL OR bot_class = '', 'Unknown (SIEM)',
    is_bot_traffic = 0, 'Human',
    notEmpty(ai_category), 'AI Crawler',
    concat('Bot (', bot_class, ')')
  ) AS "Cohort",
  round(countIf(request_method = 'GET') / greatest(count(), 1) * 100, 1) AS "GET %",
  round(countIf(request_method = 'POST') / greatest(count(), 1) * 100, 1) AS "POST %",
  round(countIf(request_method = 'HEAD') / greatest(count(), 1) * 100, 1) AS "HEAD %",
  count() AS "Total"
FROM ${raw_table}
WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND reqTimeSec < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
  AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
  AND ${traffic_type_filter}
  AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
  AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
GROUP BY "Cohort"
ORDER BY "Total" DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 30,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Method Mix by Cohort; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Disagreement between Bot Insights classification and Bot Manager scoring. Requires WAF+Bot tier.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
  ua_counts AS (
    SELECT
      class_key,
      sumIf(volume, is_bot_traffic = 1) * $scale_factor AS bi_bot,
      sumIf(volume, is_bot_traffic = 0) * $scale_factor AS bi_human,
      sum(volume) * $scale_factor AS total
    FROM (
      SELECT
        bot_class AS class_key,
        is_bot_traffic,
        cnt_all AS volume
      FROM ${summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
        AND ${traffic_type_filter}
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
        AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
      GROUP BY class_key, is_bot_traffic
    )
    GROUP BY class_key
  ),
  siem_counts AS (
    SELECT
      class_key,
      siem_bot_category,
      siem_bot_category_source,
      siem_bot_type,
      sum(volume) * $scale_factor AS siem_volume,
      avg(avg_score) AS avg_bot_score
    FROM (
      SELECT
        akamai_canonical_bot_class AS class_key,
        bot_category AS siem_bot_category,
        bot_category_source AS siem_bot_category_source,
        bot_type AS siem_bot_type,
        cnt_all AS volume,
        avg_bot_score AS avg_score
      FROM ${siem_class_summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
        AND notEmpty(bot_category)
      GROUP BY class_key, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
    )
    GROUP BY class_key, siem_bot_category, siem_bot_category_source, siem_bot_type
  ),
  siem_evidence AS (
    SELECT
      coalesce(sum(siem_volume) / $scale_factor, 0) AS siem_event_count,
      coalesce(sum(siem_volume) / nullIf((SELECT sum(total) FROM ua_counts), 0), 0) AS siem_coverage_pct
    FROM siem_counts
  ),
  siem_threshold AS (
    SELECT siem_event_count, siem_coverage_pct,
      if(siem_event_count >= 20 OR siem_coverage_pct >= 0.05, 1, 0) AS meets_threshold
    FROM siem_evidence
  ),
  use_siem AS (
    SELECT if(
      '${classification_policy}' = 'akamai_authoritative'
      AND '${has_akamai_siem}' = '1'
      AND (SELECT meets_threshold FROM siem_threshold) = 1,
      1, 0
    ) AS flag
  ),
  siem_scope AS (
    SELECT avg(avg_score) AS avg_score
    FROM (
      SELECT avg_bot_score AS avg_score
      FROM ${siem_class_summary_table}
      WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
        AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
        AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
        AND notEmpty(bot_category)
    )
  )
SELECT
  bot_category AS "SIEM Category",
  canonical_bot_class AS "Canonical Class",
  siem_bot_category_source AS "SIEM Category Source",
  siem_bot_type AS "SIEM Bot Type",
  canonical_bot_class_source,
  canonical_bot_class_confidence,
  siem_event_count,
  siem_coverage_pct,
  bi_bot AS "BI=Bot",
  bi_human AS "BI=Human",
  avg_score AS "Scoped Avg BM Score",
  total AS "Total"
FROM (
  SELECT
    uc.class_key AS bot_category,
    uc.class_key AS canonical_bot_class,
    '' AS siem_bot_category_source,
    '' AS siem_bot_type,
    'ua_dict' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
    'derived' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence,
    (SELECT siem_event_count FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_event_count,
    (SELECT siem_coverage_pct FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_coverage_pct,
    uc.bi_bot,
    uc.bi_human,
    coalesce((SELECT avg_score FROM siem_scope), 0) AS avg_score,
    uc.total
  FROM ua_counts uc
  WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    sc.siem_bot_category AS bot_category,
    sc.class_key AS canonical_bot_class,
    sc.siem_bot_category_source,
    sc.siem_bot_type,
    'akamai_siem' AS canonical_bot_class_source,
    'authoritative' AS canonical_bot_class_confidence,
    (SELECT siem_event_count FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_event_count,
    (SELECT siem_coverage_pct FROM siem_threshold) AS siem_coverage_pct,
    sc.siem_volume AS bi_bot,
    0 AS bi_human,
    sc.avg_bot_score AS avg_score,
    sc.siem_volume AS total
  FROM siem_counts sc
  WHERE (SELECT flag FROM use_siem) = 1
)
ORDER BY "BI=Bot" DESC
LIMIT 20
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 30,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Bot Manager Gap Analysis; du=${__user.login}'

panels.description: Path/status/method breakdown for selected ASNs. Shows what specific bots are doing.

targets.rawSql:
-- Uses the full-path summary by default and falls back to an ASN-scoped raw-table path-root rollup when an ASN filter is selected.
SELECT
  path AS "Path",
  bot_class AS "Cohort",
  sum(hits) AS "Hits",
  sum(hits_4xx) AS "4xx",
  sum(hits_5xx) AS "5xx",
  sum(cached_hits) AS "Cached",
  sum(cache_miss_hits) AS "Cache Miss"
FROM (
  SELECT
    request_path_norm AS path,
    bot_class,
    cnt_all AS hits,
    cnt_4xx AS hits_4xx,
    cnt_5xx AS hits_5xx,
    cnt_cached AS cached_hits,
    cnt_cache_miss AS cache_miss_hits
  FROM ${path_table}
  WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND ('${client_asn:text}' = 'All' OR (timestamp < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND timestamp >= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})))
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
    AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all'
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND bot_class NOT IN ('human', ''))
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND bot_class IN ('human', ''))
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND bot_class IN ('ai_data_scraper', 'ai_assistant', 'ai_search_crawler', 'ai_agent')))
    AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
  GROUP BY path, bot_class

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    request_path_root AS path,
    bot_class,
    count() AS hits,
    countIf(and(greaterOrEquals(toUInt16OrZero(response_status_code), 400), less(toUInt16OrZero(response_status_code), 500))) AS hits_4xx,
    countIf(greaterOrEquals(toUInt16OrZero(response_status_code), 500)) AS hits_5xx,
    countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, true)) AS cached_hits,
    countIf(equals(cache_was_cached, false)) AS cache_miss_hits
  FROM ${raw_table}
  WHERE reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND reqTimeSec < toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})
    AND ('${client_asn:text}' <> 'All' OR (reqTimeSec < toDateTime(${__from:date:seconds}) AND reqTimeSec >= toDateTime(${__to:date:seconds})))
    AND $__conditionalAll(request_host IN (${request_host:sqlstring}), $request_host)
    AND $__conditionalAll(client_asn IN (${client_asn:sqlstring}), $client_asn)
    AND ('${traffic_type}' = 'all'
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'bot' AND bot_class NOT IN ('human', ''))
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'human' AND bot_class IN ('human', ''))
      OR ('${traffic_type}' = 'ai' AND bot_class IN ('ai_data_scraper', 'ai_assistant', 'ai_search_crawler', 'ai_agent')))
    AND $__conditionalAll(bot_class IN (${bot_class:sqlstring}), $bot_class)
    AND length(request_path_root) > 0
  GROUP BY path, bot_class
)
GROUP BY path, bot_class
ORDER BY "Hits" DESC
LIMIT 50
SETTINGS
  hdx_query_max_execution_time = 30,
  hdx_query_admin_comment = 'db=${__dashboard}; dp=Endpoint Concentration; du=${__user.login}'
